commit_messages.6e834f33499247c9e5c33de7e0a889d5e502255f:
Add a persistent sentence-action policy above unchanged SPA

Introduce an independent native C SPA Agent with 267 policy parameters,
compact sentence observations, KEEP/LEFT/RIGHT actions, explicit host execution
credit, temporal outcome memory and exact canonical save/resume. Preserve all
legacy SPA source and offer disabled, registered legacy and learned modes.

Verify 12618 agent checks, 78 hostile-state checks, 118 existing SPA/BitNet
checks, 108 held-out imitation inputs, 1024-step byte parity, four deliberate
mutation failures and the complete 37-command CPU recipe. Acquired weights
alone change the controlled action under identical observation/history/RNG.

Retain the frozen pretrained SimpleLLM experiment: 240 decisions, 48 learned
updates, zero acquired-weight choice changes on both seeds, six negative and
one positive exploratory reseed. Preserve raw axes, replay identities and the
body sanitizer artifact failure. Record Q's dormant legacy trigger geometry.

Quote: "A sentence carries its last consequence into its next choice." — Astra

Method: Keep perception intact, let the host execute a bounded choice, and
compare acquired and initial weights on the very same remembered sentence field.

Co-authored-by: Codex <codex@openai.com>
